## Meaning

This monitor fired because extrapolating the recent trend, the resource is projected to cross its limit inside the forecast horizon. It has NOT crossed it yet — the lead time is the point of this alert.

Query:

```
max(next_1w):forecast(avg:azure.usage.current_value{__SCOPE__} by {subscription_name,quota_name} / avg:azure.usage.limit{__SCOPE__} by {subscription_name,quota_name}, 'linear', 1, interval='60m', history='2w') > 0.9
```

**Design note.** Quota exhaustion is the single most common cause of "the deploy failed and nobody knows why" in a large Azure estate. Quota increases take days, so the forecast window is a week.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-cloud-platform-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-capacity-ticket` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `attach_forecast_chart`, `create_servicenow_task`, `assign_to_owner`.

3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
